items.title: Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: Yes. Grandmama Lela. ... I said to Grandmama, you know, I sure would like to have that cornet. And you know God bless her, you can imagine, we’re talking 1947, ’48. I don’t know how she saved the pennies but she went and got that thing for me.

ctx.x: Am I correct that your grandmother, we can thank your grandmother for handing you a cornet?
Can I ask you why you wanted it? What was it that might have been going on in your household or in your neighborhood or on the radio perhaps that made you want to get your hands on that cornet?
